title: Water asset record
description: One asset conforming to the mWater Global Water Asset Standard v1.0. Keys are the standard's five-digit attribute codes. Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 by mWater Foundation, Inc.

00001.title: Type
00001.description: Type of asset, according to the definitions in Section 5.5

00002.title: Name
00002.description: Name used by technical staff to refer to the asset; might be left blank for many lower level assets

00003.title: Asset ID
00003.description: Unique code used to identify a particular asset in the asset register (see Section 5.2 for further details)

00004.title: Description
00004.description: Additional information to help staff locate or identify an asset

00006.title: Parent asset ID
00006.description: Asset ID of the asset that is a parent to this asset (see Section 5.3 for further details)

anyOf.description: Reference to the Asset ID of another asset.

00011.title: Location
00011.description: Geographic location of the asset on the surface of the Earth; may be a point, line, or polygon

00012.title: Location precision
00012.description: Estimated uncertainty in the geographic coordinates, expressed as a distance

00013.title: Elevation
00013.description: Height above the surface of a defined ellipsoid model of the earth’s surface, such as WGS84, or the local mean sea level; a consistent reference system should be used for all assets within a water system

00014.title: Elevation precision
00014.description: Estimated uncertainty in the measurement of the elevation

00015.title: Administrative region
00015.description: Name that describes the administrative geography of the location; multiple levels may be separated by commas starting with the most general area, for example: Region, District, Municipality

00016.title: Coverage area
00016.description: Geographical area where the water system or service provides coverage or is legally obligated to serve

00017.title: Sector
00017.description: Name for a sub-region of the coverage area that is defined by geography or the physical layout of the distribution network

00018.title: Route
00018.description: Name or number of the meter reading route, which defines those meters that are assigned to a particular staff member or team

00019.title: Address
00019.description: Physical address or postal address where the asset is located; in the case of piped connections, the address of the customer

00020.title: Urban-rural classification
00020.description: Degree of urbanization, as defined by national standards or the Degree of Urbanisation method (OECD 2021)
00020.$comment: Applicability: Type: Water system, Water point

00021.title: Community
00021.description: Name of the community, town, or neighborhood where a water system or facility is located
00021.$comment: Applicability: Type: Water system, water facility

00022.title: Accessible by road
00022.description: Asset can be accessed by vehicles using a nearby road

00023.title: Perimeter fence or wall installed
00023.description: Fence or wall exists to provide physical security for the asset

00031.title: Level 1
00031.description: Highest or most general level of categorization to which the asset belongs under the asset hierarchy

00041.title: Status
00041.description: How the asset is currently being used or operated

00042.title: Condition
00042.description: The physical or structural integrity of the asset

00043.title: Functional status
00043.description: Most recent observation of whether a water system or water point is working as designed
00043.$comment: Applicability: Type: Water system, Water point

00051.title: Current replacement cost (USD)
00051.description: Cost (in US Dollars) that would be incurred to replace the asset at the current time; this value requires regular updating based on depreciation and current market conditions; also known as CRC

00052.title: Expected useful life
00052.description: Number of years that the asset is estimated to function after installation if it is well maintained; also known as EUL

00053.title: Probability of failure
00053.description: Measure of the likelihood of a failure happening at any point in time, based on an analysis of the potential failure modes of the asset

00054.title: Consequence of failure
00054.description: Measure of the direct and indirect costs of asset failure, which may include financial, environmental, and societal costs

00055.title: Asset risk
00055.description: Business or organizational risk of asset failure, usually calculated from the probability and consequence of failure

00056.title: Original cost (USD)
00056.description: Total price paid (in US Dollars) to initially acquire an asset

00057.title: Current rehabilitation cost (USD)
00057.description: Cost (in US Dollars) that would be incurred to rehabilitate the asset at the current time

00061.title: Manufacturer
00061.description: Name of the business that produced or sold the asset

00062.title: Model
00062.description: Manufacturer’s designation for the particular model of the asset

00063.title: Serial number
00063.description: Unique identifying number or code assigned to a particular asset by the manufacturer or vendor, usually stamped or printed on the asset

00064.title: Additional technical details
00064.description: Any other technical information about the asset that is not captured by the attributes of this standard

00065.title: Installation date
00065.description: Calendar date when the asset was installed or purchased, which begins the period of useful life

00066.title: Installed by
00066.description: Name of the company or organization that originally installed or purchased the system or facility
00066.$comment: Applicability: Type: Water system, water facility

00067.title: Funded by
00067.description: Name of the funding authority, lender, or donor who funded the purchase of the system or facility
00067.$comment: Applicability: Type: Water system, water facility

00068.title: Rehabilitation date
00068.description: Date of most recent work done to restore the asset to its original level of service and extend its life

00069.title: Last service date
00069.description: Date of most recent service or maintenance performed

00070.title: Rehabilitated by
00070.description: Name of the company or organization that performed the most recent rehabilitation of the asset
00070.$comment: Applicability: Type: Water system, water facility

00071.title: Service interval
00071.description: Recommended interval at which service or routine maintenance should be performed on the asset
00071.$comment: Applicability: Type: Pump, tank, power, valve

00091.title: Upstream asset
00091.description: Asset ID of the upstream asset that supplies water to this asset

anyOf.description: Reference to the Asset ID of another asset.

00091.$comment: Applicability: Type: Pump, Tank, Treatment, Meter, Valve, Hydrant, Junction, Sampling point, Water point, Pipe

00092.title: Nominal diameter
00092.description: An approximate measurement of the internal diameter of a pipe, conduit, pump, or junction, which is used to classify according to standard sizes
00092.$comment: Applicability: Type: Meter, Valve, Junction, Pipe

00093.title: Pipe length
00093.description: Total length of pipe in a given section or run for use in hydraulic calculations and modeling

00094.title: Material
00094.description: Material of construction for pipes, junctions, valves, meters, and other liquid conduits
00094.$comment: Applicability: Type: Meter, Valve, Hydrant, Junction, Pipe

00095.title: Minor loss coefficient
00095.description: Dimensionless coefficient that can be used to account for the head loss associated with turbulence in bends, junctions, meters, and valves

00096.title: Roughness coefficient
00096.description: Dimensionless coefficient used to account for friction losses in flowing pipes in either the Hazen-Williams or Darcy-Weisbach head loss equation

00171.title: Primary contact name
00171.description: Individual or office responsible for management or administration of the water system or water point
00171.$comment: Applicability: Type: Water system, Water point

00172.title: Primary contact position
00172.description: Title or role in the organization of the primary contact
00172.$comment: Applicability: Type: Water system, Water point

00173.title: Primary contact phone number
00173.description: Phone number of the primary contact
00173.$comment: Applicability: Type: Water system, Water point

00174.title: Secondary contact name
00174.description: Additional individual who may be contacted if the primary contact is not available
00174.$comment: Applicability: Type: Water system, Water point

00175.title: Secondary contact position
00175.description: Title or role of the secondary contact
00175.$comment: Applicability: Type: Water system, Water point

00176.title: Secondary contact phone number
00176.description: Phone number of the secondary contact
00176.$comment: Applicability: Type: Water system, Water point

00181.title: Date updated
00181.description: Calendar date of the most recent update made to any attribute

00182.title: Date inspected
00182.description: Calendar date of the most recent inspection or audit of the asset, as defined by organizational asset management policies

00183.title: Alternate ID
00183.description: Optional additional identification code or number that is used by other data systems or organizations to track the asset

00184.title: Import code
00184.description: Identification code for an asset that was assigned by an external database or asset management registry, used to maintain backwards traceability for assets that have been imported

10201.title: Water system type
10201.description: Categorization of the system as a distribution network or a point source

10202.title: Network type
10202.description: Categorization of piped networks as branching or grid style

10203.title: Management type
10203.description: Type of organization that manages the operations, maintenance, and finances of the water supply system

10204.title: Number of households in service area
10204.description: Total number of households within the area that a service provider is legally mandated to offer services to

10205.title: Number of households currently served
10205.description: Number of households with a functional connection or currently able to receive service (includes households with inactive, intermittent, or cut off services, if service could be re-established)

10206.title: System or network diagram
10206.description: Photograph of a recent map or diagram showing the location of water supply and distribution infrastructure

10207.title: Total production of system
10207.description: Amount of water that the system is able to supply, within current resource and design constraints

20102.title: Process area type
20102.description: Optional label used to categorize process areas
20102.$comment: Applicability: Water facility type: Process area

30101.title: Source type
30101.description: Characterization of the source based on type of technology

30102.title: Source meter installed
30102.description: Meter is installed at the source to measure total flow

30103.title: Water quality tested
30103.description: Water quality testing has been performed at this source

30104.title: Date of most recent sample
30104.description: Calendar date of most recent water quality sampling at this source

30105.title: Name of water body
30105.description: Name of the water body supplying the source, if one exists

30106.title: Source pressure
30106.description: Pressure, or head, of the water leaving the source

30107.title: Nominal flow
30107.description: Typical or rated volumetric water flow rate that the source provides when operating as designed

30108.title: Minimum flow
30108.description: Minimum Flow rate rate that the source provides during the driest period of the year

30109.title: Maximum flow
30109.description: Maximum Flow rate rate that the source can accommodate during periods of high use or source water availability

30121.title: Well depth
30121.description: Depth below the ground surface to which the well was drilled, driven, or dug; in boreholes, this may differ from the casing depth
30121.$comment: Applicability: Source type: Borehole, Dug well

30122.title: Well diameter
30122.description: Inside diameter of the well; in boreholes, this is the drilled diameter, which will differ from the casing diameter
30122.$comment: Applicability: Source type: Borehole, Dug well

30123.title: Static water level
30123.description: Water level below the ground measured when no water is being taken from the aquifer by pumping
30123.$comment: Applicability: Source type: Borehole, Dug well

30124.title: Dynamic water level
30124.description: Water level below the ground measured when a pump is operating
30124.$comment: Applicability: Source type: Borehole, Dug well

30125.title: Groundwater temperature
30125.description: Temperature of groundwater in the aquifer or discharged by a pump
30125.$comment: Applicability: Source type: Borehole, Dug well

30126.title: Pump or lifting device
30126.$comment: Applicability: Source type: Borehole, Dug well

30127.title: Apron installed
30127.description: Apron is installed to protect the well from back-contamination by surface water and to channel drainage away from the well
30127.$comment: Applicability: Source type: Borehole, Dug well

30128.title: Monitoring well
30128.description: Well is primarily used for monitoring water levels and/or water quality rather than for water production
30128.$comment: Applicability: Source type: Borehole, Dug well

30141.title: Spring box present
30141.description: Protective brick, masonry, or concrete structure is installed around the spring so that water flows directly out through a pipe

30142.title: Spring box length
30142.description: Length of the longest side of the spring box, measured from the outside

30143.title: Spring box width
30143.description: Length of the shortest side of the spring box, measured from the outside

30144.title: Spring box depth
30144.description: Length of the vertical dimension of the spring box, measured from the outside

30145.title: Overflow pipe present
30145.description: Pipe is installed near the top of the spring box to allow water to exit when box is full

30146.title: Drain pipe present
30146.description: Pipe is installed near the bottom of the spring box to direct the flow from the spring

30151.title: Casing diameter
30151.description: Inside diameter of the well casing

30152.title: Depth of casing
30152.description: Depth below the ground to which the casing is installed; below this depth there would normally be a screen installed

30154.title: Screen length
30154.description: Length of the well screen, which is a sleeve with slots, holes, gauze, or wire wrap installed below the casing to allow entry of water and prevent entry of sand or other large particles

30155.title: Pump position
30155.description: Depth below ground to the top of a submersible pump
30155.$comment: Applicability: Pump or lifting device: Submersible

30156.title: Photo of well log
30156.description: One or more photographs of the well log, or drilling log, which usually contains a record of the soil and rock formations (lithology) encountered during the drilling of the well; may also contain data on the casing and backfill used to reinforce the well

30201.title: Pump type
30201.description: Description of the pump mechanism or operating principle

30202.title: Pump diameter
30202.description: Maximum outer diameter of a submersible pump

30203.title: Pump power rating
30203.description: Power consumed by a pump operating under normal pressure and flow conditions, as defined by the manufacturer
30203.$comment: Applicability: Pump type: NOT Hand pump

30204.title: Pump motor configuration
30204.description: Whether the motor and pump should be tracked as a single asset or as separate assets; in cases where the motor is separate from pump, this generally means that motors are interchangeable between pumps of a similar design
30204.$comment: Applicability: Pump type: NOT Hand pump

30205.title: Pump motor voltage type
30205.description: Type of electrical power required by the pump
30205.$comment: Applicability: Pump motor configuration: Integrated with pump

30206.title: Pump motor voltage
30206.description: Normal operating voltage of the pump, as recommended by the manufacturer
30206.$comment: Applicability: Pump motor configuration: Integrated with pump

30207.title: Pump motor max current
30207.description: Current drawn by the pump when operating at the maximum or full load power rating
30207.$comment: Applicability: Pump motor configuration: Integrated with pump

30208.title: Pump motor max power
30208.description: Maximum, or full load power rating of the pump, as recommended by the manufacturer
30208.$comment: Applicability: Pump motor configuration: Integrated with pump

30221.title: Design flow
30221.description: Flow rate of the pump required by the system design under normal operating conditions; should be within the acceptable flow range as defined by the pump curve

30222.title: Design head
30222.description: Head, or pressure, shown on the pump curve at the design flow rate

30223.title: Maximum flow (Q-max)
30223.description: Maximum possible flow rate shown on the pump curve

30224.title: Head at maximum flow (H-min)
30224.description: Total head, or pressure, that corresponds to the maximum flow rate on the pump curve; also referred to as the minimum head

30225.title: Minimum flow (Q-min)
30225.description: Minimum possible flow rate shown on the pump curve

30226.title: Head at minimum flow (H-Max)
30226.description: Total head, or pressure, that corresponds to the minimum flow rate on the pump curve; also referred to as the maximum head

30227.title: NPSH-R
30227.description: Net positive suction head required (or minimum) by the suction side of the pump in order to prevent cavitation and evaporation (flashing)

30302.title: Tank material
30302.description: Main material of construction used in the tank

30303.title: Tank volume
30303.description: Useful volume of the tank which can be supplied from the minimum to the maximum water levels.

30304.title: Tank shape
30304.description: Basic shape or form factor of the tank

30311.title: Tank diameter
30311.description: Diameter of the base of a cylindrical tank

30312.title: Tank height
30312.description: Distance from the bottom to the top of the tank, measured from outside

30313.title: Tank length
30313.description: Length of the longest side of the base of a rectangular tank

30314.title: Tank width
30314.description: Length of the shortest side of the base of a rectangular tank

30315.title: Height of tank bottom
30315.description: Distance from the ground level to the bottom of the inside of the tank; negative values are used for depths below the ground

30316.title: Minimum water level
30316.description: Minimum water level allowed in the tank, measured from the tank bottom; this may be the height of the outlet or the minimum height allowed by a filling control

30317.title: Maximum water level
30317.description: Maximum water level allowed in the tank, measured from the tank bottom; this may be the height of the overflow pipe or the maximum height allowed by a filling control

30321.title: Filling control installed
30321.description: Control is installed to ensure a desired range of tank fill levels

30322.title: Type of filling control
30322.description: Method or device used to maintain the water level in the tank by controlling the influent or effluent flow rate

30323.title: Fill level indicator installed
30323.description: Device is installed that provides a visual or electronic measurement of the fill level

30401.title: Power type
30401.description: Categorization of the power generating device based on design or principles of operation

30402.title: Rated power output
30402.description: Power output that can be sustained for long periods of time; for generators this is the continuous power rating

30403.title: Maximum power output
30403.description: Power output that can be provided for short periods of time in response to surges in demand; for generators, sometimes referred to as the standby or intermittent power rating

30404.title: Nominal voltage
30404.description: Voltage assigned to a system or circuit of a given voltage class for the purpose of convenient designation; the actual operating voltage may vary above or below this value

30405.title: Rated voltage
30405.description: Maximum voltage at which the power system can be operated within thermal and safety limits

30406.title: Maximum current
30406.description: Maximum safe current, or starting current, that can be supplied for a short period of time

30407.title: Type of current
30407.description: Mode of transmission for electrical current (AC/DC)

30408.title: Frequency of current
30408.description: Frequency at which the voltage rises to a peak, reverses, and rises to a peak again
30408.$comment: Applicability: Type of current: Single phase AC, Three phase AC

30421.title: Generator fuel
30421.description: Type of fuel required by the generator

30422.title: Generator apparent power
30422.description: Product of the voltage and current provided in an AC power system, which does not account for the reactive power required by inductive loads in the circuit; sometimes referred to by its most common unit of measurement: kVA
30422.$comment: Applicability: Type of current: Single phase AC, Three phase AC

30423.title: Engine cooling system
30423.description: Type of cooling system used by the generator engine

30425.title: Total number of PV panels
30425.description: Total number of photovoltaic panels installed in the power system

30501.title: Treatment type
30501.description: Categorization of treatment process by treatment method or objective

30521.title: Chlorine type
30521.description: Chemical form of chlorine used in a treatment process

30522.title: Dosing method
30522.description: Method used to add chlorine to water to be treated
30522.$comment: Applicability: Chlorination type: Sodium hypochlorite (bleach), Calcium hypochlorite, Chloramine

30601.title: Meter ID
30601.description: Identification number of code used by the service provider to identify the meter

30602.title: Meter type
30602.description: Type of metering performed: bulk metering of the distribution network versus domestic or commercial metering

30603.title: Meter design
30603.description: Design or operating principle of the meter

30604.title: Minimum measurable flow rate
30604.description: Lowest flow rate that can be measured by the meter

30605.title: Meter measurement type
30605.description: Type of measurement displayed by the meter (total volume, flow rate, or both)

30702.title: Electrical power device type
30702.description: Classification of electrical power device based on purpose or mode of operation

30801.title: Valve type
30801.description: Purpose or operating principle of a valve

30802.title: Date of last actuation
30802.description: Most recent date that the valve was actuated to prevent degradation and verify functionality

31101.title: Sampling point type
31101.description: Type of facility that allows for collection of water quality samples

31301.title: Analyzer type
31301.description: Short description of the type or purpose of the analyzer

31412.title: Perimeter total length
31412.description: Total length of the entire perimeter that is being defined as an asset

31413.title: Perimeter height
31413.description: Typical or minimum height of the perimeter

31414.title: Perimeter setback distance
31414.description: Typical or minimum distance from the perimeter from the structure or equipment it is designed to protect

31501.title: Water point type
31501.description: Type of technology used to access water

31502.title: Agricultural use
31502.description: Water point provides water that is primarily for agricultural use

31503.title: Livestock use
31503.description: Water point provides water that is primarily for use by livestock

31504.title: Meter installed
31504.description: Meter is installed at this water point

31505.title: Number of taps
31505.description: Total number of taps, such as faucets or spigots, available at a kiosk or public tap
31505.$comment: Applicability: Water point type: Kiosk, Public tap

31506.title: Kiosk tank installed
31506.description: Presence of a tank at the kiosk for storing water during planned or unplanned outages

31507.title: Connection type
31507.description: Categorization of piped connections based on the type of user or customer
31507.$comment: Applicability: Water point type: Piped connection

31508.title: Connection diameter
31508.description: The diameter of pipe used for the customer connection
31508.$comment: Applicability: Water point type: Piped connection

39901.title: Other vertical asset type
39901.description: Description or categorization of the other type of vertical asset

40101.title: Pipe type
40101.description: Category of water supply pipe type

40102.title: Pipe color
40102.description: Color or pattern painted on pipe to designate the type of fluid

40103.title: Nominal pressure
40103.description: Numerical designation of design pressure that is a convenient round number for reference purposes

40104.title: Pipe depth below ground
40104.description: Depth of the pipe below the local ground surface

measurement.description: A magnitude paired with one of the units the standard defines for that physical quantity (section 4.2).
